conditions: The source occurrence is a comment in PL/I source under the cited IBM reference edition.
limitations: Quotation marks can make apparent comment text a character string constant. The claim concerns the format in the IBM publication and leaves the ANSI subset, preprocessing controls, and other compiler editions outside its scope.

triggers: Publisher correction, exact source byte drift, or contrary release or language-boundary evidence.

statement: The IBM 6.1 reference treats comments as blank delimiters. A slash-asterisk comment can span lines until its closing delimiter. A double-slash comment ends at the end of its starting line.
